## Context

In production the footer throws while any field is a placeholder, so every public page errors. Values must not be invented.

- Owner supplies: registered name, address of the business seat, IČO 23302828 (verify in ARES), trade-licence office note, VAT status, contact and support email.
- Claude Code fills the file, sets `OPERATOR_DETAILS_CONFIRMED = true`, verifies footer, legal pages and invoices render.
